goal: Prevent database read and deserialization errors from being silently treated as missing entries
Simplify coin view lookups and ensure storage corruption aborts consistently instead of masking bugs
agreement: Support for removing coin view indirection and reducing complexity (andrewtoth, optout21)
Nonblocking objection: aborting the entire node on optional index corruption disrupts services (ajtowns)

categories.name: utils
why: P2 because standardizing read failure handling prevents silent data corruption across database users
Avoids masking disk or memory corruption as missing entries

categories.name: validation
why: P2 because it simplifies the coin view hierarchy and makes coin lookups noexcept
Prevents unreadable UTXOs from being falsely treated as missing coins during validation
